name: Notion
label: choose your install scope carefully, it's const
summary: One short form and you have credentials. The sharp edge is a setting you can't change later, and a review step the docs mention but don't explain.
verdict: Twenty minutes to working credentials. One setting you choose at creation can never be changed afterwards.
blocker: Installation scope is fixed at creation. Pick 'selected workspaces' and you can never list in the Marketplace without starting over.

steps.title: Create a public connection
steps.detail: Developer portal, Build, Public connections, Create new connection. Public is the type that supports OAuth.

steps.title: Fill in the creation form
steps.detail: Name and a development workspace, one or more redirect URIs, installation scope, and capabilities. Choose the scope deliberately.

fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.value: Per Notion's guide via Composio: https, exact match, no trailing slash

fields.label: Capabilities
fields.value: Read, update or insert content; user info

steps.title: Copy the OAuth client ID and secret
steps.detail: From the Configuration tab. Your server needs both to turn an authorization code into a token.

steps.title: Build the flow: Basic auth on the token call
steps.detail: POST to the token endpoint with a JSON body, client ID and secret base64-encoded in an Authorization: Basic header. Store both tokens and the bot_id.

steps.title: Submit for review, maybe
steps.detail: The docs say the full authorize URL appears after the connection is submitted for review. They don't say what is reviewed, whether it blocks testing in your own workspace, or how long it takes.

steps.title: Optional: Marketplace listing
steps.detail: Managed under Listings. The review process is described in a separate guide we haven't read.

nuances.text: Installation scope is set at creation and can't be changed. Selected-workspaces connections can't be listed on the Marketplace.
Every refresh returns a new access token and a new refresh token. Store the latest pair or you lose access.
Authorization is per user. Each member who wants to use the connection completes the flow.
Users can only share pages they have full access to, and the connection sees only the pages picked during consent.
Include redirect_uri on the token call if it was in the authorize URL or the connection has several.
Composio's Notion guide lists redirect URI rules: HTTPS, exact match, no trailing slash, no wildcards or fragments.
nuances.note: Secondary. Notion's own page only links to general redirect guidance.
The authorization page doesn't state how long access tokens last.

blockers.cause: The old refresh token was discarded. Each refresh issues a new pair.
Connection was created with Selected workspaces only.
blockers.fix: Create a new connection with Any workspace.

blockers.symptom: Connected but no pages are visible
blockers.cause: The user closed the flow before finishing the page picker.
blockers.fix: Handle the abandoned flow and ask them to reconnect.

redirect.rule: Configured in the developer portal. Notion's page doesn't state rules. Composio's guide says HTTPS, exact match, no trailing slash.

submission: Marketplace listing: descriptions, categories, images under Listings
